description: Zeck quota guard and operational alert thresholds (WORK-047 / D-06; the free-tier operating doctrine: meter usage, alert BEFORE exhaustion, make limits visible, no uncontrolled paid overage). Snapshots are collected from the AUTHORITATIVE stores only (the compute-plane quota tables, the queue-transport envelope counts, the execution authority's terminal outcomes, the database size) — never from provider dashboards or control planes. Provider-side quota meters (Neon/Cloudflare consoles) are out of scope without credentials and are documented NOT RUN, never claimed.

compute-claims.description: Live worker claims per compute environment vs the environment quota (the D-05 hard cap; fail-closed at the limit — uncontrolled overage is unrepresentable).

queue-backlog.description: Pending dispatch envelopes vs the backlog bound (bounded re-delivery pressure).

database-size.description: pg_database_size of the authoritative store vs the declared size limit (provider plan ceiling declared by the operator; default 5 GiB).

operationalThresholds.action: inspect dead letters with the D-03 inspection tooling (deploy/README.md D-03); dead letters are governed bounded failures — republish after the root cause is fixed
inspect failed executions through the executions authority surface; a rising failure count is a runtime defect signal, not a deployment signal
inspect the release gate evidence with deploy:release inspect; repeated gate failures block promotion by design (fail-closed)

availability.description: Control-plane availability targets (D-08 / WORK-060; AVA-001): the request-facing control plane's MONTHLY availability target per environment class, measured from typed interval observations by the D-06 release-control/observability surfaces with exact-revision identity (deploy:release availability). Fail-closed semantics are preserved: a control plane refusing to serve against a dead authority is CORRECT behavior, measured as such — the target is never met by weakening the authoritative-dependency rule. The production target may not be declared below 99.9 (unrepresentable at the loader).
